exposure: Maternal factors (over 200 factors clustered into thirteen groups)
outcome: Alpha diversity of the neonatal buccal microbiota
Beta diversity of the neonatal stool microbiota
Risk of admission of a neonate to the newborn intensive care unit
cohort: The study involved neonates and their mothers, observing the neonatal microbiota and health outcomes in the immediate postpartum period.
finding: Multiple maternal factor groups, including maternal inflammatory state, socioeconomic position, and diet, were associated with the composition and diversity of neonatal buccal, rectal, and stool microbiotas, while preterm birth and higher maternal cytokine levels were linked to increased risk of NICU admission.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with the beta diversity of the neonatal stool microbiota by 24-72 hours postpartum.
